confidence.advice: Trend under way. A+ and A.

rules.entry: Buy-stop at the 20-day highest close. Fills only if the stock opens below it and trades up into it; if it gaps above, no trade.
rules.exit: Trail the stop at close - 4x ADR once that is above your entry (so it never goes back below breakeven). 4x is the default; the app can show 2x / 6x / 8x.
rules.grade: A+ = 4-5 points, A = 3, B = 2, C = 1, D = 0 (see Setup Grades).
rules.reach: Only setups that closed within 2 ADR of their buy-stop get a pick: 98% of breakouts in the backtest triggered from that close, and the few from further away lost money.

cool_off.rule: After a stock stops you out, its breakout setups are skipped for 20 trading days. Counts losses in the forward test's plan trades and in your own account.

episodic.rules: Gap up 10%+ at the open on 3x the 50-day volume, close in the top half of the day, no more than +25% over the prior 6 months. Next session: buy at the open, stop at the gap day's low; skip it if the open is at or under the stop, or so high the stop is more than 1.5x ADR away. Same Auto exit and risk as the breakouts. Not blocked by the cool-off.
